title: Jesus... Why Do I Feel Guilty For Cancelling Plans? 😔
topic: she cancelled on her friend three weekends in a row to rest and then spent the whole Sunday feeling guilty about it

bible.text: And He said to them, “Come with Me privately to a solitary place, and let us rest for a while.” For many people were coming and going, and they did not even have time to eat.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... why do I feel guilty every time I cancel plans? 😔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Three weekends in a row now. I just wanted my own bed and quiet.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You cancelled one evening. You didn't cancel the friendship.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But she asked again, and I said no again. Good friends show up, right?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Resting isn't letting her down. I told My own friends to come away and rest.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Rest isn't a debt you owe. It's how you come back a better friend.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: When did you last rest without guilt? 👇
